title: Multimedia Inteligente: media library y media_type sobre ADR-014
description: Extender el sistema de Conditional Knowledge Media (ADR-014) sin crear tablas paralelas. Añadir columna media_type (image/testimonial/flyer/other) a knowledge_items, persistirlo en el API de items (POST/PATCH), retornarlo en resolveConditionalMedia, y crear dashboard de Media Library en el panel: listar assets con imagen, filtrar por tipo, subir imágenes (reusa /api/knowledge/media/upload), editar descripción/trigger/tipo y eliminar. Mejorar el matcher de triggers para soportar varios términos.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: 8 files affected, schema changes required, AI behaviour changes, cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (10): architect, database, backend, frontend, ai_engineer, performance, security, qa, release, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: Extensión de ADR-014 sin tablas paralelas: reutiliza knowledge_items + chat_media_dispatched + bucket knowledge-media. Columna media_type con CHECK, matcher multi-término, media library UI reusando APIs existentes. Respeta multi-tenant, RLS y dominio de ventas.
